item.title: Koi-Labo.
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Diva
  • 発売日: 2010-02-26
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: こいらぼ
  • 英語名: Koi-Labo.

あらすじ

An university student majoring in arts, Ryou heads to Kaikyouku to become a teacher-in-training. While traveling by boat to the town, he could hear an unpleasant sound. A girl nearby offers him a pair of headphones and tells him that he can’t live on the island without them. Later he finds out that her name is Karen and she is the class rep in his assigned class.

item.title: Fuyu no Rondo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Diva
  • 発売日: 2008-10-31
  • スコア: 7.18/10 (38 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 冬のロンド
  • 英語名: Fuyu no Rondo

あらすじ

There is a small country located in the Arctic Circle. The main character moves there after his father’s remarriage. He is confused at first, but his new mother and four sisters take a good care of him. Actually, the sisters are princesses, but they live a simple life. Especially, Victoria always thinks about her citizens. He is attracted by her noble character and gradually falls in love with her… However, the princesses in his country usually get married to someone important in neighboring countries. The main character thinks it is wrong to marry someone you don’t love, but Victoria accepts it for her citizens…
